issues.on_page: p4: Repairs and maintenance 23,556 (General Fund only); p5: R&M -Street 2,166
issues.issue: The split is backed by the same fund's own breakdown on p5 (Sewer 0 + Street 2,166 + Park 21,390 = 23,556), so it's allowed and marked split_from/computed. But original_label isn't the printed label, and 2,166 is printed on p5, not on the cited source_page 4, so the page-text check may flag it.

issues.on_page: Fund balance - end of year 929,401 (= Cash with County Treasurer 264,401 + Investments 665,000, p3)
issues.issue: beginning_cash/ending_cash are fund balances that include investments, while ending_investments 665,000 is also filled in. That matches the roll-forward and notes explain it, but anyone adding cash + investments would double count 665,000.

issues.on_page: Warrants issued prior year paid (118,313) under Other financing sources and uses
issues.issue: Recorded as printed in the financing section, but paying off prior-year warrants is repaying debt; it's arguably debt service principal. The identity holds either way.
